increment: Caller-owned task adapters and strict config-only experiment preflight/run

support.native_config_only_execution_path: implemented; verified with mocked executor only in this increment
support.third_domain: test-only alert-threshold adapter; baseline 80, rejected candidate 40, accepted candidate 70

public_api.protocol: optimization_framework.contracts.TaskAdapter: id, describe(), baseline(), validate_candidate(config), evaluate(snapshot, baseline)
public_api.registration: from optimization_framework.registry import default_registry; registry = default_registry(); registry.register(MyTaskAdapter())
public_api.empty_registry: from optimization_framework.registry import TaskRegistry; registry = TaskRegistry()
public_api.service: from optimization_framework.service import OptimizationService; service = OptimizationService(root, registry=registry)
public_api.preflight: service.preflight(document) -> ready receipt with verified baseline and immutable task/evaluator pins
public_api.run: service.run_experiment(owner, document, idempotency_key, background=False) -> persisted run
public_api.host_cli: from optimization_framework.cli import main; main(argv, registry=registry, copilot_executor=None)
public_api.native_authority: Host supplies allow_model_calls=True plus configured CopilotExecutor separately. CLI requires --allow-model-calls. Document cannot grant either.

cli_commands: python3 -m optimization_framework run --experiment DOCUMENT --root PRIVATE_ROOT --idempotency-key KEY
Legacy run --task ID --executor deterministic|copilot and native flags preserved; document and policy flags cannot be combined.

acceptance_cases: Explicit adapter instance registration; duplicate and unknown ids refuse
Closed schema validation; unsupported keywords, invalid patterns, booleans as numbers, duplicate JSON keys and unknown fields refuse
Test-only third domain evaluates immutable source/config fixtures offline and through mocked native authoring
Expected config read-back, rejected candidate retained, bounded repair, accepted restore verified
Core source hashes and loaded framework module set unchanged during third-domain registration/run; no import discovery
Existing GET /api/tasks returns injected third task; HTTP routes unchanged
CLI preflight creates no storage and performs no executor dispatch; document run persists receipt and policy
Document model grants/imports/commands, policy flag conflicts, unknown metrics/check references and mismatched pins refuse
Failed baseline blocks native authoring; direct legacy start retains failed baseline evidence
Caller native limits and separate model permission enforced; attempt/deadline exhaustion never fabricates acceptance
Task/evaluator runtime drift and constant replacement refuse restoration; stable repeated preflight pins
Malformed, missing, empty and extra evaluator results cannot forge passing acceptance
Owner refusal and document-aware idempotency preserve existing service behavior

limitations: Extension is trusted host code installation. Documents select existing ids; they cannot load arbitrary classes, imports or commands.
Only source.py plus config.json snapshots and one or two offline submission fixtures are supported. No general code authoring, repository migration or production domain adapter is claimed.
Adapters execute in-process as the caller. Source/bytecode pins detect covered changes but are not an OS sandbox, independent evaluation or transitive dependency/global-state attestation.

Task authors must expose behavior-affecting state in describe/baseline and keep it stable. Evaluator source modules must be inspectable. Pins include runtime bytecode and may change across interpreter versions.
Deadline is enforced between trusted calls; a running synchronous evaluator cannot be forcibly interrupted. Native authoring receives remaining deadline budget.
Primary metric and quality-check references are frozen, but no comparative promotion rule or baseline change-effort measurement is implemented. Every run decision remains inconclusive.
Native path evidence in this increment is mocked. Real credentials, model availability, live behavior, cloud deployment and production safety are unverified.
Existing core collection is 77, not the requested 79; identity of two additional expected tests is unknown.

README, skills, specifications, deployment, frontend, metrics and reporting implementation are outside writable scope and unchanged. This additive contract/report is the implementation support record; older prose about hardcoded registration/preflight was not reconciled here.
